mira_peops: Quick heads-up — final stretch for the review window. We have a few canary calibration slots and an overflow backup plan. Please read and react. :eyes:

sam_peops: TL;DR — forms lock at 11:59pm PT on Friday. Calibration sessions run Mon-Wed next week. If you need a swap, reply here with slot you have and slot you want.

jordan_mgr: Noted. Can I move my Wed 10:00 slot to Tue 16:00? I have two conflicting biz reviews.

mira_peops: @jordan_mgr yes — tentative swap ok. @priya_mgr can you pick up Wed 10:00 if available?

priya_mgr: I can take Wed 10:00 but prefer remote takeover. That work?

mira_peops: Great — remote is fine. I'll update the calendar invite and add dial-in. :white_check_mark:

ken_dir: Heads up — if a manager no-shows to a calibration slot, reviewers should escalate to the on-call reviewer pool. review-bot will auto-assign an overflow reviewer after +10m.

review-bot: AUTO: Overflow reviewer assignment enabled for slot 2024-05-14T10:00Z. Contact list: priya_mgr, jordan_mgr, ken_dir.

sam_peops: Quick process note for handbacks: if you need to hand back a packet, use the CSV in the shared drive and add a short comment in the sheet. We will not accept handbacks via DMs.

mira_peops: CSV snippet (paste into the Shared Drive sheet):
```
reviewer,packet_id,reason_short
jordan_mgr,PKT-482,conflict - biz review
priya_mgr,PKT-523,scope overlap
```

priya_mgr: Copy. Also, can we get a manager checklist for calibration prep? A 1-page checklist helps new leads.

mira_peops: Yep — uploading a 1-pager now. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/rdw/reviews/calibration-checklist (internal). It includes a two-minute calibration script and suggested examples to surface.

jordan_mgr: One operational ask — will QA be running quick spot checks on form completeness before lock? Last time a handful were incomplete.

sam_peops: Yes. We run a nightly validation job that flags missing competencies or absent reviewer comments. We'll DM managers who have flagged forms. The job runs at 02:30 PT daily until lock.

ken_dir: If someone needs an exception past midnight for urgent circumstances (LOA, medical), escalate to people-ops with a short justification. We will fast-track approvals but need the justification in the sheet.

mira_peops: Filing reminder: final calibration notes must be uploaded to the packet before the form lock or they'll be ignored by export. Export time = 12:05am PT (gives us 6 minutes to run the job).

priya_mgr: Are there any extra calibration canary slots this week for overflow reviewers who want backup practice?

mira_peops: Yes — we added two canary slots Thurs 18:00 and Fri 09:00 PT. Sign-up sheet here: https://sheets.redwood.com/rdw/canary-signup (internal).

jordan_mgr: Signing up for Thurs 18:00. :thumbsup:

sam_peops: For managers covering multiple teams: if reviewer load > 12 packets, ping people-ops so we can split packets and assign a secondary reviewer. We'll also apply review-pairing to keep loads under 15.

mira_peops: Final logistics checklist (short):
- forms lock: 2024-05-17 23:59 PT
- export run: 2024-05-18 00:05 PT
- calibration week: 2024-05-20 to 2024-05-22
- canary overflow slots: 2024-05-16 18:00 PT, 2024-05-17 09:00 PT
- exception requests: people-ops@redwood (include packet IDs)

priya_mgr: Thanks — can you add a note in the calendar invites about the auto-assign overflow rule? Some managers were surprised last cycle.

mira_peops: Done. Invite note updated.

ken_dir: One last ask — please remind ICs to finalize self-assessments by EOD Wednesday so managers have 48 hours to review before calibration.

sam_peops: Will do a targeted ping to ICs in the product and eng channels tomorrow morning.

review-bot: REMINDER: Forms lock in 72 hours. Actions: finalize self-assessments, finalize reviewer comments, check shared CSV for handbacks.

mira_peops: Thanks everyone — flag here if any swaps or exceptions pop up. I’ll follow up with a short post on the schedule and the sign-up sheet at 10:00am PT.

jordan_mgr: Appreciated. :pray:

priya_mgr: All set on my end.

sam_peops: Closing out — will aggregate swaps and publish final calendar by EOD today.

mira_peops: (closing) Published final calendar + checklist. Link updated in the sheet. Good luck team! :rocket:
